work_schedule_days_work_time_check.name: work_schedule_days_work_time_check
work_schedule_days_work_time_check.value: ("work_schedule_days"."enabled" = 0) or ("work_schedule_days"."start_time" is not null and "work_schedule_days"."end_time" is not null and "work_schedule_days"."start_time" < "work_schedule_days"."end_time")

work_schedule_days_break_check.name: work_schedule_days_break_check
work_schedule_days_break_check.value: ("work_schedule_days"."break_start" is null and "work_schedule_days"."break_end" is null) or ("work_schedule_days"."break_start" is not null and "work_schedule_days"."break_end" is not null and "work_schedule_days"."break_start" < "work_schedule_days"."break_end")

work_type_versions_verifier_check.name: work_type_versions_verifier_check
work_type_versions_verifier_check.value: ("work_type_versions"."verification_mode" = 'dispatcher' and "work_type_versions"."ai_verifier_connection_id" is null) or ("work_type_versions"."verification_mode" = 'ai_model' and "work_type_versions"."ai_verifier_connection_id" is not null)
